attBesluta.text: Heavy duty. Delivery girl said the package was heavier than it should be. Exactly what I needed.
Truly a good heavy duty trailer hook! very stable to tow a heavy trailer without worry!

Had a small issue with the stand. Vevor stepped up and took care of the issue!! Sent me a full replacement instead of just the 1 part that wasn't machined properly. Customer service was amazing!!! So so worth the money. Having 2 types of pads to hold the car is great Very versatile!!!

A great axle stand for supporting and moving the suspension while in the air. Compared to another stand I had where only the center rod moved, they are a little less stable; however, for the price, you can't go wrong. I highly recommend these to anyone.
I accidentally dropped it off a ladder twice, the plastic case has no cracks at all. Sturdy enough for daily construction site use.
It holds steady when pulling several thin wires together, no backward slipping.
